title: The Guardian's Test
summary: Ha-Jun faces the 15-foot Skeletal Centurion in a brutal trial of martial skill and sovereign authority, realizing brute force cannot crack ancient bone armor.

panels.action: The Centurion slams his 8-foot bone claymore down with catastrophic kinetic force.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion slams his 8-foot bone claymore down with catastrophic kinetic force.
panels.prose_hi: Centurion ne pralayankari gatij bal ke saath apni 8 foot ki haddi ko clamor se neeche patak diya.

panels.action: A 30-foot shockwave tears through the petrified floor, launching boulders and bone shards into the air.
panels.prose_en: A 30-foot shockwave tears through the petrified floor, launching boulders and bone shards into the air.
panels.prose_hi: 30 foot ki shockwev pathreele farsh ko chirti hui, pattharon aur haddiyon ke tukdon ko hawa mein uchhalti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun flips backwards in midair, wind buffeting his jacket as the shockwave rips beneath his boots.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flips backwards in midair, wind buffeting his jacket as the shockwave rips beneath his boots.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hawa mein peeche ki or palat jata hai, hawa uski jacket ko jhatka deti hai aur shockwev uske jooton ke neeche se takrati hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun lands lightly atop a sheared bone pillar, panting as white limestone dust swirls around him.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar woh blow touch bhi ho jata... toh instant death thi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands lightly atop a sheared bone pillar, panting as white limestone dust swirls around him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek kate hue haddi ke khambhe par halke se utarta hai, hanfta hua jaise safed chuna patthar ki dhul uske charon or ghumti hai.

panels.action: The Centurion spins with unnatural speed, sweeping the colossal blade in a 360-degree horizontal scythe.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion spins with unnatural speed, sweeping the colossal blade in a 360-degree horizontal scythe.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian aprakritik gati se ghumta hai, 360-degri kshaitij skith mein vishal blade ko ghumata hai.

panels.action: The bone pillar beneath Ha-Jun's feet is sliced through like butter, toppling forward.
panels.prose_en: The bone pillar beneath Ha-Jun's feet is sliced through like butter, toppling forward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke pairon ke neeche ka haddi ka khambha makkhan ki tarah katkar aage ki or gir jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks off the falling slab, diving headfirst toward the Centurion's exposed neck with Sanguine Fang.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kicks off the falling slab, diving headfirst toward the Centurion's exposed neck with Sanguine Fang.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne senguin fang ke saath centurion ki khuli gardan ki or gota lagate hue, girte hue slab ko laat mari.

panels.action: The crimson crystalline blade strikes the Centurion's hardened collarbone—and violently deflects with blinding sparks!
panels.prose_en: The crimson crystalline blade strikes the Centurion's hardened collarbone—and violently deflects with blinding sparks!.
panels.prose_hi: Crimson crystaliy blade centurion ke kathor collerbon se takrata hai - aur chakachaundh chingari ke saath hinsak roop se vikshepit ho jata hai!

panels.action: Ha-Jun's blade vibrates violently in his grip; the Centurion's bone doesn't show even a scratch.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ek kharoch tak nahi aayi?! Iski density steel se bhi das guna zyada hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's blade vibrates violently in his grip; the Centurion's bone doesn't show even a scratch.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka blade uski pakad mein hinsak roop se kampan karta hai; centurion ki haddi par ek kharonch tak nahin dikhti.

panels.action: The Centurion's massive armored backhand sweeps across, swatting Ha-Jun like an insect.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion's massive armored backhand sweeps across, swatting Ha-Jun like an insect.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian ka vishal bakhtarband backhand, ha-jun ko ek keede ki tarah nigalta hua aage badhta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smashes into the solid limestone wall 40 feet away, cracking the stone and coughing blood.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smashes into the solid limestone wall 40 feet away, cracking the stone and coughing blood.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun 40 feet door thos chuna patthar ki deewar se takrata hai, jisse patthar toot jata hai aur khoon nikalne lagta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding to floor spitting crimson
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides down into the rubble, clutching his bruised ribs as blood trickles from his mouth.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides down into the rubble, clutching his bruised ribs as blood trickles from his mouth.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni chotil pasliyon ko pakadkar malbe mein gir jata hai kyonki uske munh se khoon bah raha hota hai.

panels.action: Kuro swoops down, screeching into Ha-Jun's ear: 'Taqat se mat lado, bewakoof!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Woh First Sovereign ki army ka Vanguard tha! Uski body externally indestructible hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro swoops down, screeching into Ha-Jun's ear: 'Taqat se mat lado, bewakoof!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro jhapatta maarta hai aur ha-jun ke kaan mein chillata hai: 'taakat se mat lado, bewkuf!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun wipes blood from his chin: 'Toh ise defeat kaise karun?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bahar se nahi tootega toh kahan se todein?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wipes blood from his chin: 'Toh ise defeat kaise karun?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni thuddi se khoon ponchta hai: 'to ise kaise haraun?!'.

panels.shot: kuro pointing claw at centurion chest
panels.action: Kuro gestures toward the giant's ribcage: 'Soul Core! Uske sternum ke andar soul flame burn ho rahi hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Khoon fluid hai... Gap dhoondo aur andar penetrate karo!

panels.prose_en: Kuro gestures toward the giant's ribcage: 'Soul Core! Uske sternum ke andar soul flame burn ho rahi hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro vishal ki pasliyon ki or ishara karta hai: 'sol kor! uske sternam ke andar soul flame burn ho rahi hai!'.

panels.shot: centurion stomping forward with heavy thuds
panels.action: The Centurion marches toward Ha-Jun, dragging the bone blade along the floor with a terrifying screech.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion marches toward Ha-Jun, dragging the bone blade along the floor with a terrifying screech.
panels.prose_hi: Centurion bhayanak cheekh ke saath haddi ke blade ko farsh par ghasitate hue, ha-jun ki or badhta hai.

panels.action: The giant mocks him: 'IS THIS ALL THE SOVEREIGN'S HEIR HAS TO OFFER? A WEAKLING COWERING IN DUST!'

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: TUM SOVEREIGN KE THRON KE LAAYAK NAHI HO!

panels.prose_en: The giant mocks him: 'IS THIS ALL THE SOVEREIGN'S HEIR HAS TO OFFER? A WEAKLING COWERING IN DUST!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal ne uska mazak udaya: 'kya samprabhu ke uttaradhikari ko yahi sab kuch dena hai? dhul mein dooba hua ek kamzor vyakti!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing up with cold eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly pushes himself to his feet, violet and crimson flames swirling inside his irises.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mujhe kisi ke throne ki parvah nahi... Mujhe apne bhai ko bachaana hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slowly pushes himself to his feet, violet and crimson flames swirling inside his irises.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhire-dhire khud ko apne pairon par khada karta hai, baingani aur lal rang ki laptein uski aankhon ki putliyon ke andar ghum rahi han.

panels.shot: ha-jun dissolving blood blade into liquid
panels.action: Ha-Jun releases the solid form of The Sanguine Fang; the blade liquefies into four swirling red serpents.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun releases the solid form of The Sanguine Fang; the blade liquefies into four swirling red serpents.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne the senguin fang ka thos roop jaari kiya; blade dravit hokar char ghumte lal saanpon mein badal jata hai.

panels.action: Instead of retreating, Ha-Jun sprints directly at the Centurion with maximum explosive acceleration.
panels.prose_en: Instead of retreating, Ha-Jun sprints directly at the Centurion with maximum explosive acceleration.
panels.prose_hi: Pichhe hatne ke bajay, ha-jun adhiktam visfotak tvaran ke saath sidhe centurion ki or daudta hai.

panels.shot: centurion thrusting sword like battering ram
panels.action: The Centurion thrusts the colossal sword point-blank straight at Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion thrusts the colossal sword point-blank straight at Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian ne vishal talwar sidhe ha-jun ki chhati par mari.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding on knees beneath the blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides along his knees across the bone floor, slipping clean under the giant blade's guard.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides along his knees across the bone floor, slipping clean under the giant blade's guard.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne ghutnon ke bal haddi ke farsh par fisalta hai, vishal blade ke pehre ke neeche saaf fisalta hai.

panels.action: From directly beneath, Ha-Jun sees the glowing azure soul flame burning behind the giant's interlocking ribs.
panels.prose_en: From directly beneath, Ha-Jun sees the glowing azure soul flame burning behind the giant's interlocking ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Sidhe neeche se, ha-jun ko vishal ki aapas mein judi pasliyon ke peeche chamakti neela aatma ki lau jalti hui dikhai deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun ring blazing like a star
panels.action: The Ring of Hollow Blood radiates blinding scarlet light as Ha-Jun channels his entire remaining mana.
panels.prose_en: The Ring of Hollow Blood radiates blinding scarlet light as Ha-Jun channels his entire remaining mana.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ha-jun apne poore shesh man ko prasarit karta hai, khokhale rakt ki anguthi chakachaundh kar dene wali lal roshni bikherti hai.

panels.shot: four blood serpents compressing into a needle
panels.action: The four swirling streams of blood condense into a hyper-dense, razor-thin crystalline blood needle.
panels.prose_en: The four swirling streams of blood condense into a hyper-dense, razor-thin crystalline blood needle.
panels.prose_hi: Rakt ki char ghumti hui dharayen ek atyant saghan, atyant patli crystaliy rakt sui mein sanghanit hoti han.

panels.action: The blood needle slips perfectly through the millimeter gap between the third and fourth petrified ribs.
panels.prose_en: The blood needle slips perfectly through the millimeter gap between the third and fourth petrified ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Rakt ki sui teesri aur chauthi pathrili pasliyon ke beech millimeter ke antar se puri tarah se fisalti hai.

panels.action: Inside the ribcage, the needle detonates into a radiant blossom of crimson thorns, puncturing the soul flame.
panels.prose_en: Inside the ribcage, the needle detonates into a radiant blossom of crimson thorns, puncturing the soul flame.
panels.prose_hi: Pasli ke pinjare ke ander, sui lal rang ke kaanton ke ek ujjwal phool mein footati hai, jo aatma ki lau ko chhedati hai.

panels.action: The colossal giant freezes solid, azure flames spilling outward through every bone seam like cracks in glass.
panels.prose_en: The colossal giant freezes solid, azure flames spilling outward through every bone seam like cracks in glass.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal vishal thos jam jata hai, kaanch ki daraaron ki tarah har haddi ki silai ke madhyam se neeli laptein bahar ki or failti han.

panels.action: The 8-foot bone broadsword slips from the giant's fingers, crashing thunderously onto the limestone floor.
panels.prose_en: The 8-foot bone broadsword slips from the giant's fingers, crashing thunderously onto the limestone floor.
panels.prose_hi: 8 foot ki haddi wali chaudi talwar vishal ki ungaliyon se fisalkar chuna patthar ke farsh par jor se takrati hai.

panels.shot: centurion slowly bending knee to hajun
panels.action: The titanic guardian sinks to one knee before Ha-Jun, bowing its massive horned skull in deep reverence.

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: Thou hast the precision of the First Sovereign... I yield.

panels.prose_en: The titanic guardian sinks to one knee before Ha-Jun, bowing its massive horned skull in deep reverence.
panels.prose_hi: Titanik sanrakshak ha-jun ke samne ek ghutne ke bal baith jata hai aur apni vishal seeng wali khopdi ko gahri shraddha se jhuka deta hai.
